measurement.name: Mindanao Current
measurement.range_interpretation: Approximate range in the author’s prose description of one averaged surface section; not uncertainty, seasonal extrema or a paired-boundary full width.
measurement.geographic_scope: Oblique mean line from 8.16 N, 126.61 E to 8.77 N, 130 E off Mindanao. Profiles within 80 km were projected and objectively mapped; not an along-current envelope.
measurement.section_orientation: Oblique mean line; reported offshore distance retained without converting it to paired cross-flow edges.
measurement.layer: Surface expression of averaged absolute geostrophic equatorward flow. The 0–1000 m glider velocity reference is not a fixed measurement layer for this extent.
measurement.time_convention: Spatial and temporal mean of glider profiles; campaign context June 2009–July 2014. Exact contributing dates of the Figure 2 mean unresolved.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author-reported offshore extent of equatorward mean flow, not a diagnosed pair of current boundaries. Figure 2 contours are 0.1 m/s intervals; no numerical extent threshold assigned.
measurement.source_citation: Schönau et al. (2015), The Mindanao Current: Mean Structure and Connectivity, Oceanography 28(4), 34–45, doi:10.5670/oceanog.2015.79.
measurement.source_locator: Printed p.38 / PDF p.6, Velocity and Transport, glider paragraph and Figure 2a; mean-line sampling described on pp.36–37 / PDF pp.4–5.
measurement.extraction_method: 250–300 km transcribed from p.38 prose after inspecting Figure 2a; no edge digitization, midpoint or route buffer.
remaining_gates: Obtain contributing profile dates and machine-readable velocity fields.
Diagnose paired edges with a consistent threshold before full-width or seasonal ranges.
Independent scientific and canonical admission review.

mean_offshore_context.source_date_discrepancy: p.35 describes intended repeated sections June 2009–January 2014; p.36 reports deployments June 2009–July 2014. Neither supplies exact profiles entering Figure 2.

excluded_alternatives: Abstract ~300 km is a rounded overview, not a second independent measurement.
Historical 200 km and later 150 km at 300 m estimates have different layer and sampling support; no seasonal min/max pooled.
50 km offshore is the core position, not current width.
250–350 km describes a secondary core position that may be an eddy, not a width range.
300 km transport integration boundary is not an observed current edge.
Mindanao Undercurrent is a separate northward subsurface flow.
